description: Deprecated (GX-11, D-070): the gate tier is explicit (gate-hooks/tier.sh, D-B5) and the KD1 switch reads forge-events.adjudicated_tiers. These modes are only the fallback of scripts/lib/gate_tier.py when no tier was derived (a caller outside gate-local); gate_report still passes them in. It stays registered until a later revision removes it (GX-26; schema compat).
